senses.gloss:
n. 
__1 An udder (changed to ऊधन् in Bah. Comp. ऊधसोऽनड् [[P. V. 4. 131.]] ) भुबं कोष्णेन कुण्डोध्नी मेध्येनावभृथादपि [[R. 1. 84.]] 
__2 A covered secret place to which only friends are admitted. 
__3 The bosom. 
__4 The breast of a cattle. 
-Comp. 
-वती (a female, female animal) with full udders; [[Bhāg.]]
or ऊधस्यम् Milk (produced from the udder); ऊधस्यमिच्छामि तवोपभोक्तुम् [[R. 2. 66.]]
